name: Achiacharus
description: Son of Anael, Tobit's brother, and so Tobit's nephew; cupbearer, keeper of the signet, steward and overseer of the accounts under Sarchedonus; interceded for Tobit's return to Nineve and nourished him in his blindness; in Tobit's closing words, brought by Aman out of light into darkness yet saved, unlike Aman himself

points: His nephew Achiacharus rose to be cupbearer, keeper of the signet and steward under Sarchedonus, spoke for him, and Tobit returned to Nineveh; he had looked out for his people and the Lord had his own look out for him.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
